title: Mounted domain readers observe real owning writes
description: Use an isolated gateway, launch-time fixtures and real browser views. Independent protocol writers and an external rule-file rename update PR, assessment, analytics and copilot readers. Provider execution is not claimed. Commands remain live-only; no runner launch is included.

proofTargets.claim: A real lifecycle command updates the mounted monitor and visible button without Refresh.
An external rule-file replacement updates the mounted rule without Refresh.
Malformed rules retain stale displayed data with errors and disabled commands, then recover.
Real feedback updates the mounted fixture assessment before its retained timer.
A real other-project backfill updates mounted filtered charts and global dimensions.
A real configuration command updates the mounted stopped copilot without launching it.

prove.intent: Prove real owning writes update mounted domain readers on one isolated runtime.

pr-monitor.intent: An independent lifecycle writer changes the mounted monitor and actual button.

pr-rules.intent: An external atomic rule change reaches the mounted canonical rule collection.

pr-source-error.intent: Rule source errors retain stale data, refuse commands and recover from repaired bytes.

assessment.intent: Actual feedback updates the selected fixture record before the retained timer.

analytics.intent: A real backfill of another project updates the open filtered aggregate.

copilot.intent: The mounted copilot follows an independent configuration write without starting a runner.
